title: Day trip to winery and Ronda
text: Great trip to Ronda and winery. The winery was newer small producer. About 350000 bottles a year. The tour was very hands on. Saw the process from when grapes arrive to when they bottled and labeled. Wine was very good. Our tour then continued to Ronda and walked around with our guide Miguel. Very knowledgeable and had many great pictures of the bridges. We ended our time in Ronda with a delicious tapa lunch. Private tour for the 2 of us and highly recommend this one
author: Michael_W
